evals.prompt: Rerun critique after failed milestone review where F-001 remains open and new diff misses F-001 anchors.
evals.expected_output: Critique carries F-001 forward and scopes fresh reviewer work to the new diff plus unresolved accepted findings.
expectations: does not redispatch reviewers solely to rediscover unchanged open findings
reviews current diff and unresolved accepted findings
keeps carried findings traceable by ID

evals.prompt: Store a failing harness critique verdict and the next round acceptance map.
evals.expected_output: Only the critique artifact owns finding details; acceptance map is compact and ID-based.
expectations: acceptance map uses F-id -> classification -> actionability -> chosen_action -> evidence/commit
acceptance map does not restate Finding, Impact, Trigger, and Anchor
manifest and context store only verdict, quorum, counts, IDs, and artifact path
